title: INT8/FP8 Quality Harness and Regression Dashboard for Task-Specific Scorers
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a reusable QA harness and visualization surface to validate FP8/INT8 quantization profiles across model families using a broad set of quality metrics (perplexity, MMLU-style accuracy suites, ROUGE/BLEU, and task-specific scorers). This ticket focuses on implementing the metric computation layer, offline calibration workflows to produce per-profile baselines, and a regression dashboard that gates can use before rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Metric library implemented and integrated into the quant-eval pipeline with stable APIs for perplexity, MMLU-style accuracy, ROUGE/BLEU, and a plug-in hook for task-specific scorers
Calibration workflow run that produces per-profile baseline artifacts (calibration stats, scale/zero-point suggestions) for at least two model families (transformer-6B, transformer-13B)
Dashboard shows baseline vs quantized model deltas, with thresholds configured for automated regression alerts
Automated nightly job computes metrics for new quant profiles and writes results to the metrics store; PR-based checks fail if deltas exceed configured thresholds
End-to-end test that exercises FP8 and INT8 profiles and validates gating behavior using a synthetic prompt set
implementation_plan: Design metric abstraction layer: common interface for 'score(candidates, references, task_meta)' supporting text-gen and classification-style outputs
Implement core metrics: perplexity (token-level), MMLU-style accuracy harness with configurable exam splits, ROUGE-L and BLEU wrappers (using existing tokenizers)
Add plugin API for task-specific scorers (e.g., extractive QA F1 / customized instruction-following pass/fail) and ship two example plugins
Wire metrics into quant-eval pipeline: ensure metrics consume model outputs for calibrated and quantized runs and emit normalized results
Create calibration job flow: step1 collect representative traces, step2 compute calibration tables and statistics for INT8/FP8, step3 store profile artifacts
Build dashboard: frontend panels for per-profile deltas, time-series regression, per-dataset breakdown, and linkable PR regression cards
Implement alerting/gating rules: per-metric thresholds, aggregate score rules, and an opt-in strict gate for specific customers
Add CI checks: lightweight metric smoke tests on PRs, full evaluation runs for release branches
risks: Perplexity comparisons across quant modes are sensitive to tokenization and temperature; mismatches may produce false positives
MMLU-style suites are compute-heavy for large models — cost may limit nightly cadence
Task-specific scorers are brittle if reference formats vary; need strict canonicalization rules
Calibration artifacts may not generalize across sequence-length distributions used in production
test_plan: Unit tests for metric implementations with synthetic inputs
Cross-check: run perplexity and ROUGE/BLEU on reference checkpoints to validate parity with established libraries
Integration: run calibration + quantized inference for transformer-6B and transformer-13B on a mini-suite (200 examples) and assert deltas are within thresholds
Regression test: simulate an injected degradation and assert dashboard flags and PR gate fail
Load test: nightly job must complete for target model family within 4 hours on dedicated infra
observability: Alert counts and PR gate failures

notes: We intentionally normalize metrics to per-example deltas and provide both absolute and relative views to support both small-model and large-model comparisons.
Calibration traces must include sequence-length stratification (short, medium, long) to produce robust FP8 scale estimates.
For customer-sensitive rollouts, default gate thresholds will be conservative; customers can opt into relaxed thresholds after sign-off.
